intro.name: Chatnarint Boonsaeng
intro.summary: Computer Engineering student with hands-on experience in software development using Flutter. Currently exploring Rust to deepen my understanding of programming and low-level concepts. Passionate about software engineering, problem-solving, and continuously improving through hands-on learning.

technologies.details: React, Flutter, Tanstack (router, query), Tailwind, React Native, Axum, Fastapi
GCP, Cloudflare, Vercel, Terraform, Docker, OrbStack, Containerlab
Git, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL, Vim, NeoVim, Nano, iTerm2

educations.head: King Mongkut's Institute of Technology Ladkrabang

details: MassageHubs — Developed a mobile application for purchasing and redeeming gift certificates across four client branches in California. Contributed to both application development and system design.

EazeMe — Designed the system architecture and developed separate mobile applications for customers and massage therapists, supporting at-home massage services with location-based matching to connect customers with the nearest available therapist.

Mashares — Developed the UI and application logic for a co-working space booking application. Implemented features including news updates, meeting room reservations, 3D printer access, and other workspace services.

CaraTrip — Developed core features including user authentication, profile management, and route search using the OpenRouteService API. Customized map tiles and map styling to align with the application's visual design.
Learned and applied Flutter and Dart fundamentals, including reusable components, grid layouts, state management, responsive UI design, and widget-based development through hands-on practice.
Developed an Apple Calculator clone using Flutter and Dart, implementing both the user interface and calculation logic to recreate the core functionality and design of the original application.

Developed a delivery application called Sushi Drop using Flutter, integrating OpenStreetMap and OpenRouteService API for map functionality, latitude/longitude coordinates, and route visualization. Implemented a basic real-time chat system using WebSocket, including image sharing.
Built a DrinksOnMe clone application using Flutter for the mobile frontend and Node.js with WebSocket for real-time communication, gaining practical experience in frontend-backend integration.
Implemented and practiced Flutter animations, gesture handling, and interactive UI components, including a Tinder-style swipe feature with left and right card interactions.
